conclusion: All independently measured native focus cases kept the pre-focus viewport scale. The shared floor rendered at 16px for 100% Page Zoom and 19px for 85%, including both tracking selects in portrait and landscape at reduced zoom.
limits: Simulator evidence, not a physical iPhone test.
Search stayed focused with the software keyboard through landscape rotation; a separate new landscape search focus baseline was not measured.
100% landscape episode select was tapped and its native picker opened, but the older QA overlay clipped its scale reading, so that case is excluded from scale proof.
85% landscape search metrics were observed in the CUA screenshot but no standalone PNG was saved for that case.
No native iPad or split-view testing, physical-device testing, or pinch-zoom stability rerun in this task.
Only 100% and 85% native Page Zoom were tested in this task.
Simulator drag and scroll did not move the page through CUA; the optional QA button used scrollIntoView without focus to reveal the status select. Native taps performed the focus actions.
